summary.text: Michael Rosen is the Independent Party of Washington candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 41-Position 2, facing Democratic incumbent My-Linh Thai in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Rosen described himself as an attorney, investor and Washington-licensed nutritionist and named accountability, affordability and health as his key messages.

paragraphs.text: Michael Rosen graduated from Mercer Island High School and earned a bachelor's degree from George Washington University in 2000, a law degree from the University of Miami in 2007, and a graduate degree from the National University of Natural Medicine in 2022.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as investor.
Rosen advanced from the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary with 33.3 percent of the vote to Thai's 66.7 percent.

In the survey, Rosen said he is a fourth-generation Washingtonian born and raised on Mercer Island and argued that state spending has more than doubled in two decades while accountability, affordability, public safety and health outcomes have worsened.
He wrote that he thinks independently and follows evidence, and he listed accountability, affordability and health as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
